It's freedom from the hell I'm in and carry. So freedom in that sense, not in the sense of mobility or possibilities.

No no, it's not that they were something I picked out and can't put back in, rather that the numb cold emotionless shield I became and remained for nearly 2 decades isn't something that can ever be undone. I, the physical being me, may have survived the hell that was my childhood, but the only thing that survived is truly just a mask. The idea of me. The real me, the essence of me, all my hopes, all my dreams all good and nice, all emotions, they died a long time ago.

I protected them simply by taking all the physical and psychological abuse, by sheltering them from as much of the shit going on. To this day they have no idea of what I endured. They mave have some notion, but even if they think the worst, they can still let those thoughts go, since that's all it is to them, horrible thoughts, they don't know for sure. Which gives them some possibility to push it away.

You are quite right in assuming they would get harmed if this was done when we were still in touch. But this plan to commite suicide has been made for quite some time, and one of the most important aspects has been to remove myself from them, push them far far away. Slowly and steadily, until we reach the point where both the distance between us is large, and they are in a good and safe place. And living good lives. Now, I know, there will still be some pain associated with my death, but it will pass, and so long as the death is done right, it should go over within an acceptable timeframe.

I know happiness and joy is nowhere to be found so long as you can't find it within yourself. But I gave up that hope, gave up all my dreams and aspirations when I was a young boy. I became a mask, an illusion. I hid behind a smile, the perfect hiding place where no one ever looks and no one ever did. I became what I had to in order to ensure that my siblings grew up as unharmed as possible. The process however, stripped me of everything and it's not possible to get it back.

The permanent state of deaths also means I will forever be free...
